text:
alex: Quick sync — planning to enable a circuit-breaker rollback for requests that hit an unpinned default model next week. Need a concise client-impact checklist + docs changes. Thoughts?

megan: +1. We should be explicit about the header and status codes clients will see. Short checklist: SDK header opt-in, server error semantics, example curl/python snippets, and a migration note. :thumbsup:

jen: What exact behavior are we returning when we force fallback? 409 vs 426? Need to be consistent across endpoints (chat/generate/embeddings).

prateek: Leaning toward 426 Upgrade Required with a structured body that includes `supported_versions` and `fallback_model`. That makes programmatic migration easier.

alex: I like 426 too. Proposal: response includes `code: "MODEL_PIN_UNAVAILABLE"`, `fallback_model`, and `recommended_action` string. Deprecation window for the old default pin behavior = 30 days.

sasha: Can we add a client-side quick-check snippet to detect this and auto-retry with the fallback? Small example would help integrators.

megan: Example snippets — include both header negotiation and explicit model pin:

```bash
# curl: prefer server default, allow fallback
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Accept-Version: v2" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

# If server returns 426 + fallback_model, client should retry:
# GET the fallback field and resend with `model: fallback_model` in body
```

```python
# python SDK example (pseudocode)
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status_code == 426 and 'fallback_model' in resp.json():
    fallback = resp.json()['fallback_model']
    resp = client.generate(prompt, model=fallback)
```

jen: Need to call out SDKs: JS/Python/Go should expose an explicit `on_version_change` hook and automatic retry toggle. Also add tests for telemetry events so SRE can track rate of fallbacks.

prateek: Ops/monitoring: emit a metric `api.fallbacks.count{route,model}` and alert if rate spikes > 1% of traffic for 5m. Add a log field `pin_decision=rollback` for tracing.

alex: Docs work: devex to add a short migration guide explaining: what 426 means, sample retry logic, server header names, and SDK flags. @devex: sasha can you own examples + changelog blurb?

sasha: I can do examples + changelog. Will add a small section "Handling model pin rollbacks" with code samples and a checklist for platform users.

megan: Backwards-compat note: if a customer pins a model via API param `model=...` we never force a rollback — pin wins. This only affects unpinned/default selection. Call that out clearly.

jen: For compatibility, include a feature flag `enable_pin_circuit_breaker` on the control plane so we can toggle per-customer while we monitor. Also plan a canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days.

deploy-bot: rollout-schedule: circuit-breaker-toggle -> canary 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (5%), 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z (25%), 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z (100%).

alex: Action items: (1) prateek add metrics+alerts PR, (2) megan + sasha write docs + snippets, (3) jen update SDK contracts & add retry hooks, (4) infra enable feature flag and canary config. Aim to merge infra + SDK changes by 2026-03-22.

prateek: I'll open the monitoring PR today and add the alert runbook.

jen: I'll draft the SDK interface PR and ping reviewers @eng, @devex.

megan: Will sketch the docs + example PR and include the migration blurb.

alex: Nice. One more subtlety — what do we return for embeddings endpoints where clients might not expect streaming? Keep same 426 with structured JSON body.

jen: ACK. We'll update the response schema in openapi and generate new SDKs.

sasha: I'll include a small section in the docs about testing: `curl` tests and a local shim script to simulate a 426 response.

alex: Sweet. If no objections, we'll proceed with that plan. Thanks everyone.

megan: No objections from me.

jen: SGTM.

prateek: SGTM.

sasha: 👍 will start on examples.
